A magical rod that can cast extreme cold in a wide range. These are crafted from refined ice found at the summit of Hebra Peak. It will break when depleted.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 10 |durability = 32 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = Ice flurry attack }} {{Compendium/Extract|Blizzard Rod}} Blizzard Rods are one-handed [[Weapon]]s. They are superior counterparts to [[Ice Rod]]s, crafted from refined [[Ice]] found at the summit of [[Hebra Peak]]. Blizzard Rods are most commonly wielded by [[Blizzrobe]]s. Blizzard Rods are imbued with Ice elemental energy, generating three flurries of Ice when swung. However, Blizzard Rods are fragile and will break easily if they make direct contact with [[Object]]s or [[Enemy|Enemies]]. Blizzard Rods will also break simply from extended use. If [[Link]] executes a [[Spin Attack]] while wielding a Blizzard Rod, he will loose eight blasts at once in different directions. They also provide one level of [[Heat Resistance]], though they have no effect in Scorching Climates. When thrown with the [[R Button]], Blizzard Rods will not leave Link's hand, and they will instead produce three flurries of Ice that will advance in the direction they are thrown. Blizzard Rods will temporarily lose their magical properties if used excessively, requiring a brief cooldown period before they can be used again. When Link speaks to [[Kula]] in the [[Korok Forest]], he will ask to be shown a "rod with the power of ice," which he describes as having the power to freeze [[Monster]]s.{{Cite|[I'll do it!] Hooray! Show me a {{Color BotW|Red|rod with the power of ice}}, please! You can wave this rod to freeze monsters in their tracks! {{Color BotW|Blue|Ice Wizzrobes}} love to wreak havoc with them.|Kula|BotW}} After listening to him, Link will receive the "[[A Freezing Rod]]" [[Side Quest]]. If Link brings a Blizzard Rod to Kula, he will be amazed by how it sparkles.{{Cite|Is that a {{Color BotW|Blue|blizzard rod}}?! Incredible shimmer! Unbelievable sparkle!|Kula|BotW}} As a reward, Kula will give Link a [[Gold Rupee]].{{Cite|Thank you, Mr. Hero. Your weapon is so amazingly, wonderfully sparkly! I must give you something as thanks!|Kula|BotW}} Blizzard Rods are not made of flammable materials and thus can safely be used around open [[Fire|Flames]] or [[Scorching Climate]]s. Blizzard Rods are also not made of magnetic materials and cannot be manipulated with [[Magnesis]].
